title: Supplier preview forecast checks pass; initial browser verification blocked by missing system libraries
summary: The standalone supplier preview's JavaScript parsed successfully and offline assertions passed for the sample seven-day cost of 2094 pesos, rounded top-up of 1200 pesos, post-top-up reserve, repeated short-validity renewals, paused rules, horizon boundaries, invalid cycles and chart-bucket totals. The static preview server returned HTTP 200. Browser setup initially failed under sandbox DNS and executable visibility restrictions; approved execution downloaded Chromium, but launch then failed because libatk-1.0.so.0 is absent. Browser layout and interaction checks have not yet run. These checks use fictional data and do not establish a live payment or account response.

evidence.description: Standalone sample-data preview and pure forecast model.
Inline script syntax and forecast invariants passed; browser launch failed before page evaluation.

nextSteps: Install the required browser runtime libraries through the approved environment mechanism, then verify desktop/mobile layouts and preview interactions.
If runtime setup remains unavailable, explicitly report the browser verification limit.
